description: Payment gateway service provider offering credit card, convenience store, carrier, and other online payment processing solutions.
auth_notes: Uses merchant ID, connection ID, and encrypted or hashed request authentication parameters for secure server-to-server API connectivity.
credential_notes: Requires entering into a merchant contract, business screening, and sales outreach to obtain production or sandbox credentials.
api_notes: Covers comprehensive online payment operations including authorization, capture, refunds, cancellations, and status inquiries across multiple payment methods.
mcp_notes: No official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exists from Paygent; none found in the community either.
rationale: A developer cannot obtain API credentials self-serve because setting up an account requires commercial contracts and business verification.

evidence.note: Main site detailing Paygent payment gateway services, connection types, and merchant support.
